requestedCompany: UGI Electric transmission and distribution utility business
rationale: Create one manager-level record for UGI Utilities' separable Pennsylvania electric transmission-and-distribution business. UGI Utilities remains the current legal owner. Funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP have signed an approximately $470 million definitive purchase agreement, but UGI's August 2026 Form 10-Q still classified the business as held for sale and expected closing in UGI fiscal Q2 2027, subject to approvals. Argo therefore must not appear as an active owner before legal closing.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count the regulated Pennsylvania electric transmission, distribution and retail utility business once. Exclude UGI Utilities' gas division, UGI Corporation, generation businesses, individual lines, substations, customers and regulatory dockets. Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC and related acquisition entities are transaction vehicles for the same target, not separate PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: No existing production or evaluated-seed company represents this business.

ownershipResolution.currentLegalOwner: UGI Utilities, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of UGI Corporation

pendingOwnershipTransactions.counterpartyName: Funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP / Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC
pendingOwnershipTransactions.transactionDescription: Definitive agreement to acquire UGI Utilities' Pennsylvania Electric Division for approximately $470 million, subject to working-capital adjustments, customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

ownershipResolution.duplicateOwnerAction: Create no Argo ownership period until legal closing is directly evidenced.

operatingResolution.description: UGI Utilities – Electric Division is a regulated electric transmission, distribution and retail utility serving more than 63,000 customers in Luzerne and Wyoming counties in northeastern Pennsylvania. The business operates approximately 2,700 miles of transmission and distribution lines and 14 substations. UGI Utilities remains the current legal owner while funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP pursue regulatory approval for an approximately $470 million acquisition expected to close in the first quarter of calendar 2027. The exact Argo fund, manager-level stake, standalone legal suffix, headquarters, founding year and separate website are not publicly disclosed. No legal close, termination, resale or revised closing timetable was identified through August 16, 2026.

acquisitionExitCheck.announcement: The definitive agreement was announced on April 28, 2026.
acquisitionExitCheck.regulatoryStatus: FERC docket EC26-118-000 was filed on June 26, 2026 by UGI Utilities, Inc. and Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC; UGI continued to describe the transaction as subject to applicable regulatory approvals in its August 2026 Form 10-Q.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitOrTerminationSearch: No closing, termination, resale, replacement buyer or revised timing was identified through August 16, 2026.
